data.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Cobalt Health builds scheduling software for clinics in Germany and the Netherlands.

What you'll do

  • Build features with React and Node.js
  • Maintain PostgreSQL queries and migrations
  • Containerise services with Docker

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience with JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs
  • Willingness to learn Docker

Nice to have

  • German language skills
